title: Its very similar to the Slap Chop
text:
Its very similar to the Slap Chop. I've owned a slap chop as seen on TV, and this is pretty much a new edition of the same product. I was hoping it would be somewhat improved from the original one made famous by infomercials, but sadly the same problems I had there exist here.
To be clear- for some things, it works great. chopping items without skin for example is pretty straight forward. But if you take a cucumber and try to slap it into chopped pieces, you end up with half of it still attached to the skin and the other half mushed into a pulp. There's a very fine line between too little chopping and too much. You also can't really control the size of the outcome very well. The idea is good and for certain things it will work well- chopping up hard boiled eggs for egg salad for example. Or Tuna with some peppers and spices, etc. But I was really hoping this would be good for israeli salad or pico de gallo, and it is just a little disappointing on that.
